import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if len(data) < 2:
        return
    a = int(data[0])
    b = int(data[1])
    print(f"Bitwise AND: {a & b}")
    print(f"Bitwise OR: {a | b}")
    print(f"Bitwise XOR: {a ^ b}")
    print(f"Bitwise NOT (first number): {~a}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
